svg.title: Separate provider traffic from process I/O

g.text: Separate provider traffic from process I/O
The implementation must expose what it actually observes.

g.title: Provider requests and responses
g.desc: Source: mock backend. Available to both Playwright and standalone consumers.
g.text: Source: mock backend. Available to both Playwright and standalone consumers.

g.title: Consumer-supplied process observations
g.desc: Source: consumer instrumentation. Injection settings alone do not observe process invocation.
g.text: Source: consumer instrumentation. Injection settings alone do not observe process invocation.

g.title: Exact stdin / stdout / terminal interaction
g.desc: Consumer process hooks supply this data. Backend traffic cannot reconstruct exact process I/O.
g.text: Consumer process hooks supply this data. Backend traffic cannot reconstruct exact process I/O.

g.title: Raw I/O compatibility remains open
g.desc: Raw input capture must preserve PTY behavior, signals and resizing; a transparent proxy has not been proved.
g.text: Cordyceps need not run or proxy the process; observation must use the consumer’s integration.
Architecture proposal · no library implementation claimed
